tldr: For binary potential outcomes and a prescribed treatment count, uniform complete randomization is jointly minimax among all outcome-blind exact-quota designs and clipped full-record estimators. Its finite minimax risk has an exact two-count primal-dual representation and terminating rational upper and lower certificates. Along every scarce sequence, R(n,m)~1/(4m); the nonlinear gain over difference in means is (1/2)m^{-3/2}+o(m^{-3/2}) when m=o(n^{2/3}). The sharp gain, transition structure, and limiting reconstruction for the remaining scarce sequences are open.
